learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn calculations for multicomponent systems.
Students will learn to perform computer-aided calculations to determine the dew point.
Students will learn to determine the bubble point by performing computer-aided calculations.
Students will learn algebraic approaches to multicomponent systems.
Students will learn the calculations in the UNIFAC model.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to advanced calculations in multicomponent separation systems
Equilibrium calculations for binary vapor-liquid and ternary liquid systems
Analysis of equilibrium separation processes and algebraic approaches
ASOG and UNIFAC methodologies and examples
bibliography: Poling, John M. Prausnitz, John P. O'Connell - The properties of gases and liquids
Smith, Van Ness, Abbott - Introduction to Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics
